atmosphere_layer.name: Atmosphere (Gaseous Envelope)
atmosphere_layer.description: Thin outer layer of gases (primarily nitrogen and oxygen) surrounding Earth and retained by gravity.

biosphere_continents.name: Biosphere & Continental Landmass
biosphere_continents.description: Global ecological zone integrating all living organisms and their interactions with the lithosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere.

hydrosphere_ocean.name: Hydrosphere (Oceans & Surface Water)
hydrosphere_ocean.description: Combined mass of water found on, under, and above the surface of the Earth, dominated by global oceans.

earth_crust_lithosphere.name: Crust (Outermost Rocky Lithosphere)
earth_crust_lithosphere.description: Thin, brittle outermost solid rock shell of the Earth that together with the rigid upper mantle forms the lithosphere.

silicate_mantle.name: Mantle (Silicate Magma & Asthenosphere)
silicate_mantle.description: Thick middle layer of hot, dense silicate rock beneath the crust where slow convection currents drive plate tectonics.

liquid_outer_core.name: Liquid Outer Core (Molten Iron & Nickel)
liquid_outer_core.description: Molten metallic layer of iron and nickel surrounding the inner core whose convection generates Earth's magnetic field.

solid_inner_core.name: Solid Inner Core
solid_inner_core.description: Extremely hot, dense solid sphere of iron and nickel at the center of the Earth kept solid by immense pressure.
